subject: Marketplace entitlements & SKU mapping — Acme listing follow-up
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:55:00 -0400
Subject: Request: entitlements, deployment patterns & SKU mapping for Acme listing

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the initial seller profile. To complete the listing we need three items from Redwood:

1) A matrix of entitlements / product SKUs you plan to publish for each cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and how those map to our metering dimensions (BYOT, vCPU, subscription tier, seats, etc.).
2) Short descriptions of typical deployment patterns (single-tenant VPC, shared multi-tenant, private deployment via Marketplace private offers) and the minimum supported instance types.
3) Confirmation on billing reconciliation windows and whether you support consolidated billing / invoice-level passthrough.

Can you provide these as an attached matrix and a short architecture doc? Also note any entitlements that require additional approvals (SOC2, FedRAMP scoping).

Timeline: AWS needs this by EOD Thursday (6/19) to keep to the June marketplace batch. If you need a short extension let us know.

Thanks,
AWS Marketplace Ops
Marketplace Seller Onboarding
Amazon Web Services

[Attachment requested: entitlement matrix template]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, GCP Marketplace Review <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 12:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: entitlements, deployment patterns & SKU mapping for Acme listing

Hi —

Appreciate the checklist. Attached are three artifacts that should cover the ask:
- entitlement-matrix.xlsx (maps Redwoods’ product SKUs to AWS/Azure/GCP metering dimensions)
- sku-mapping.csv (flat export for partner ingestion)
- deployment-architectures.pdf (short descriptions of our supported deployment patterns and minimum instance sizing)

High level answers inline:
1) Metering mapping: we publish SKU per feature-tier (starter/pro/flex/enterprise). For cloud metering we support: subscription (monthly), per-concurrent-session (metered via tokens), and fixed-node (reservation) billing. The entitlement matrix flags which SKU supports which metering dimension per cloud. See sheet 'cloud_map'.
2) Deployment patterns:
  - Hosted Redwood API (multi-tenant) — default for hosted customers, supports standard marketplace subscriptions. Minimum: 8 vCPU equiv (2xA100-style GPU pool) for production tenants.
  - Dedicated / Reserved Pools — enterprise customers can reserve GPU pools in a region; this maps to a fixed-node SKU.
  - Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) — supported via private offers; we provide a deployment playbook and image bundles.
3) Billing reconciliation: we support monthly invoice windows and can provide consolidated billing via marketplace passthrough for AWS and GCP; Azure requires partner MCA flagging for invoice passthrough — we have an MCA template.

Approvals: SOC 2 Type II and internal penetration test reports are available on request; FedRAMP not supported today but we can provide scoping notes for DoD customers.

Notes: Karthik and Marcus are on-copy for any SKU/price clarifications. Attaching files now.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: entitlement-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]
[Attachment: sku-mapping.csv (CSV, 6KB)]
[Attachment: deployment-architectures.pdf (PDF, 125KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: entitlements, deployment patterns & SKU mapping for Acme listing

Stephanie — quick clarifications from product side before we send final matrices to AWS:
- In entitlement-matrix.xlsx, under 'enterprise' SKU we need to confirm whether the 'per-concurrent-session' metering supports both streaming and non-streaming models (answer: yes for hosted, no for private). Please mark that explicitly.
- For the minimum supported instance note: please replace '2xA100-style GPU pool' with the explicit minimum GPU SKU we support per cloud (we support A10G and A100v4 equivalence; list each).

Marcus — can you confirm the MCA template link we include for Azure passthrough? If we have the doc, I'll inline it into the deployment-architectures.pdf and re-export.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP Product — Serving Runtime

From: Jenna Morales <jenna.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace entitlements & SKU mapping — Acme listing follow-up

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick delivery — I reviewed the attachments. A couple of asks from Acme procurement before we mark the package as complete for our internal vendor onboarding:

- Can you confirm whether the Enterprise SKU supports consolidated invoicing across multiple Acme business units (we have three billing centers)?
- We need an explicit statement that Redwood accepts PO-based payments and that net-30 terms are available for enterprise commitments; please include standard payment remittance details.
- Please provide a DocuSign link for the seller-side marketplace private offer (we prefer to review terms in DocuSign).

If you can reply by midday we'll be able to keep the vendor onboarding on track for July procurement sync.

Best,
Jenna Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
